comparison_basis: Controlled comparison: same source files, population path, household-size path, completion rate and remaining defaults; only completion lag differs. Historical completion timing and stock/replacement calibration are recalculated consistently.

historical_classification.other: Extra space + vacancy + retirement-village adjustment + unexplained building
historical_classification.market_excess: Not separately identified in historical data
historical_classification.overbuild_absorbed: Not separately identified in historical data
historical_classification.warning: Historical other/unallocated may contain excess supply, but it also includes unexplained residual and omitted or mismeasured components; it is not a measured historical overbuild series.

forecast_classification.net_replacement: Demolition replacement + recent replacement wave + unconsented additions
forecast_classification.other: Extra space + vacancy and any released-vacancy terms
forecast_classification.overbuild_absorbed: Negative floor area corresponding to the modelled payback

population_household_note: Household-size settings are unchanged. The next Stats NZ 2023-base family and household projection release should be assessed as a separate input update.
time_resolution_note: Monthly consents are shifted month by month for completion timing. Demographic demand remains annual; quarterly population and stock series are not interpolated into pseudo-monthly observations.
